title: Implement resolveWindow for rolling and calendar windows
description:
Implement the pure function resolveWindow(spec, now, timezone, dayStart) returning UTC millisecond bounds plus a human label. Specs: today, yesterday (calendar windows in the configured timezone at the configured day-start, default local midnight); last-24h, Nh, Nd (rolling, UTC-relative); all; absolute since/until bounds override the spec. Inclusion is start-inclusive, end-exclusive.

Done when: a message at 03:59 with day-start 04:00 falls into yesterday and one at 04:00:00 falls into today; rolling windows ignore timezone; the label echoes the resolved window (for example: today 04:00-04:00 America/Los_Angeles).

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Implemented src/sentiment/windows.ts resolveWindow(spec, now, timezone, dayStart, bounds): calendar today/yesterday anchored at day-start (default 00:00), rolling last-24h/Nh/Nd UTC-relative to injected now, all, and absolute since/until overriding the spec. Start-inclusive, end-exclusive. Label echoes the resolution (e.g. 'today 04:00-04:00 America/Los_Angeles'). 03:59 with day-start 04:00 lands in yesterday; 04:00:00 lands in today; rolling windows ignore timezone. Outcome: green.
